title: The Little Stone That Grew
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The king forgot the thing he saw,
And no one knew the way;
So Daniel asked for just a while
To kneel right down and pray.

[Chorus]
A little stone, cut without hands,
Rolled on and grew and grew;
It filled the earth, a mountain tall,
His kingdom, strong and true.

[Verse 2]
He called his three good friends to come,
"Will you all pray with me?"
And Heavenly Father showed him all
The secret he must see.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Then Daniel said, "I thank Thee, Lord,
For wisdom and for might;
Thou knowest what the darkness hides,
And with Thee dwells the light."

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
When Scout could not find his blue sock,
He stopped and asked in prayer;
Ask first, then look, and you will see
That Heavenly Father's there.

[Chorus]
mood: Discovery music. A small harp figure turns over and over under the voice like a question being asked, circling and not yet landing. In each chorus the harp opens into a rolling pattern that keeps gathering, a little stone rolling and growing, with a soft cello line climbing one note at a time underneath. Curious at the start, sure and bright by the last chorus, never louder, only clearer.
